core_obligations: Write L_K as a difference of effective Cartier divisors on the regular generic fibre
Extend both divisors over the valuation ring via smoothness

proof_roadmap.step: Write L_K as a difference of effective Cartier divisors on the regular generic fibre

difficulty_reason: Prove valuative existence for Picardstack_{X/B} with X -> B smooth and proper: extend an invertible L_K on the generic fibre over the valuation ring R; X_K is Noetherian, separated and regular (finite presentation plus smooth over a field), so L_K is the difference of O(D_K) and O(D'_K) for effective Cartier divisors (Noetherian regular separated Pic generated by effective Cartier divisors); smoothness of X over R lets both divisors extend to effective Cartier divisors D, D' subset X (smooth-over-valuation-ring-effective-Cartier), and O(D - D') extends L_K.
